migration.description: Add an independent nullable OAuth request-compression algorithm to pool routing settings and resolve missing legacy values to zstd.
migration.release_unit_description: OAuth upstream request compression support in the r4p9x account-policy release unit.

durable_state.description: The pool_routing_settings OAuth request-compression default and the existing group/account nullable policy overrides.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite pool_routing_settings.oauth_request_compression_algorithm plus existing nullable group/account policy columns.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Existing installations with the pre-OAuth-compression schema and supported same-Major pool settings states.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: Current candidate head; release version is not selected by this record.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Idempotently add nullable pool_routing_settings.oauth_request_compression_algorithm; existing databases and fresh schemas use the same nullable shape.

dml_changes.description: Do not rewrite existing rows. Resolve NULL or absent legacy values to zstd at runtime; write only explicit operator values or the existing default on new settings rows.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: No historical row rewrite is required. Runtime defaulting is deterministic and preserves all existing API-key settings and group/account overrides.

progress_signals: Schema maintenance reports the existing column or successful idempotent creation.
Settings reads expose zstd for NULL/legacy rows and preserve explicit values.
OAuth attempt telemetry records the actual algorithm and compression mode.
pause_points: After the idempotent column check before any settings write.
After runtime resolution and before enabling OAuth upstream dispatch.

recovery.program_rollback_state_behavior: Older binaries ignore the additive nullable column and continue to read/write existing API-key settings; they do not silently remove the OAuth value.
recovery.faulty_release_recovery: Repair forward with a subsequent program version; do not down-migrate or rewrite the nullable column during application rollback.
recovery.backup_restore_role: Restore a pre-change SQLite backup only as separate disaster recovery; rerun idempotent schema maintenance after restore.

required_test_evidence: Legacy schema upgrade creates the nullable column and resolves NULL to zstd.
Repeated startup maintenance is idempotent and preserves explicit OAuth and API-key values.
Old clients omitting the OAuth field preserve the stored value.
Focused SQLite inheritance and settings API tests pass; current candidate CI and review remain pending.
